The quality of these manually-written headlines was checked by professional editors from the perspective of the factual aspect of the media frame. Low-quality headlines, e.g. containing wrong factual information, inconsistent with the news body, too-short or overlong, etc., are removed.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on personalized news headline generation as a specialized form of text summarization. It uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BLEU) and human evaluation (103 annotators creating gold-standard headlines). The main contribution is the PENS dataset and framework for injecting user preferences into headline generation.
